data.one_liner: A scrollable Flutter widget with a sticky footer.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable widget using SingleChildScrollView and CustomMultiChildLayout that keeps a footer sticky at either the bottom of the screen or the end of the scroll body. It supports dynamic heights for child widgets in the scroll body.
use_when: You need a scrollable view with a footer that sticks to the bottom or the end of the content.
Your scroll body contains a limited number of child widgets.
avoid_when: You have a large number of child widgets in the scroll body, due to performance reasons with SingleChildScrollView.
You require lazy-loaded list views like ListView.builder for massive datasets.
strengths: Supports dynamic height of child widgets in the scroll body.
Footer can stick to the bottom of the screen or the end of the scroll body.
weaknesses: Not recommended for use with lots of child widgets for performance reasons.
